dossier_meta.context_text: Here $\varepsilon^*(\alpha) = \inf_{G:\,\bar{\alpha}(G)\geq\alpha}(\bar{\alpha}(G) - \alpha^*(G))$, where $\alpha^*(G)$ is defined via an optimal partition of $V(G)^r$ and a positively-correlated random-subset distribution with Bernoulli$(1/2)$ marginals. This conjecture would imply Conjecture 2.6 and hence Levine's conjecture.
